fda.category2_status: Mechano growth factor pegylated (PEG-MGF) is listed under 'Bulk drug substances nominated but withdrawn'. Page content current as of 04/22/2026.
fda.category2_text: Compounded drugs containing Mechano Growth Factor Pegylated (PEG-MGF) may pose significant risk for immunogenicity for certain routes of administration and may have complexities with regard to peptide-related impurities and API characterization. FDA has not identified any human exposure data on drug products containing PEG-MGF administered via any route of administration. FDA lacks important information regarding any safety issues raised by PEG-MGF, including whether it would cause harm if administered to humans.

ndc_directory.note: One bulk-ingredient (API powder) listing named 'MGF (Mechano Growth Factor) Acetate', with its active ingredient coded as mecasermin (the name for full-length recombinant IGF-1). A listing is a registration, not an FDA approval. Labeler not named here.

fda.note: Zero adverse event reports is not evidence of safety; unapproved products bought online are rarely reported.

wada.list: World Anti-Doping Agency 2026 Prohibited List, S2.3 Growth Factors and Growth Factor Modulators: 'Mechano growth factors (MGFs)'; prohibited at all times; non-Specified.

patent_note: UCL Business / University of Illinois family (priority 2005-03-18) describes MGF E-domain peptides modified for stability, including PEGylation. Google Patents lists the WO publications as ceased and the US application as abandoned.
